description: Copies a stream into a new draft: its settings, playlists (items and playing order), linked destinations and YouTube settings; never its schedule. A scene stream's copy plays the same scene as the original, not a copy of it: editing the scene changes both. `copied` lists what was carried over.

name.description: Name of the copy. Omitted: the original's name with "(copy)".

name: stream_create_copy
title: Copy stream
